Hi Marissa,

We received Invoice 2026-02 (attached) but our treasury team has a couple of questions before they can release the wire:

- LumenTech will be sending a SEPA/Euro-denominated wire. Your invoice is in USD. Can you confirm if Redwood can accept EUR directly or provide an EUR IBAN for the EU entity to avoid FX conversion fees?
- Historically our intermediary banks have deducted ~€25–€35 in intermediary charges when sending to US accounts, which causes a shortfall on your side. Can you confirm whether Redwood will invoice the shortfall or if we should explicitly request OUR charges at our bank?
- If we send EUR to a USD account, what FX rate / conversion fees will Redwood apply when posting the payment? Will the amount be converted by our bank or by your receiving bank?

Please also confirm the VAT treatment — we are B2B in Germany (VAT ID: DE123456789). Should the invoice be reissued with reverse-charge references? We need a VAT-capable invoice to process in our system.

Attaching: Invoice_2026-02_Redwood.pdf (the PDF you sent).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Payment instructions and VAT invoicing for Redwood invoice 2026-02

Hi Anne — thanks for the heads up and the VAT ID. Quick answers below and full wire instructions attached. Looping in Priya from finance for VAT handling.

1) EUR vs USD: We can accept EUR payments directly to our EU bank account to avoid FX conversion. Please see the EUR details in the attached wire file (Wire_Instructions_LONG.txt). Using the EUR IBAN will prevent conversion on our side and should avoid intermediary currency conversion.

2) Intermediary bank fees: These are typically deducted by correspondent/intermediary banks. If you instruct your bank to send with OUR (sender) charges, we should receive the full billed amount. If the payment is sent with SHA/BEN, intermediaries commonly deduct their fees from the beneficiary amount and that results in a shortfall. Redwood does not automatically credit/absorb intermediary bank charges for one-off invoices; we request that customers use OUR for critical payments.

3) FX rates: If you send EUR to our USD account, the conversion will generally be performed by the receiving bank at their commercial rate, and any conversion-related costs are not billed by Redwood — they are part of the banking/payment path. To avoid this, please use the EUR IBAN provided in the wire instructions.

VAT: Because LumenTech is a B2B EU entity with a valid VAT ID, we can reissue the invoice under reverse charge (no VAT charged). Priya, could you generate a reverse-charge invoice and send to Anne within 2 business days?

I attached the wire instructions and have also attached a copy of the current invoice for reference. If you prefer, we can also accept payment in USD if your treasury requires that — just confirm whether your bank will apply OUR.

Next steps:
- Anne to confirm which account (EUR IBAN or USD) they will use and whether they will set OUR.
- Priya to issue reverse-charge VAT invoice if applicable.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Wire_Instructions_LONG.txt (text)]
